# dsh-formula-docx

Turn Markdown into a `.docx` whose equations are **real Word equation objects**
(OMML) — double-clic
kable and editable in Word, correct in WPS, sharp in PDF.

把 Markdown 变成公式是 **Word 原生公式对象**（OMML）的 `.docx`：在 Word 里可双击编辑，
WPS 正常打开，导出 PDF 不糊。不是公式图片，也不是上标下标拼出来的

## Why / 为什么

Documents with dozens of formulas are where normal Markdown-to-Word pipelines
fall apart: formulas a

rrive as images, or as `x²`-style character hacks, or as
LaTeX source that nobody can edit later.

公式密集的文档最容易在这一步翻车：公式变成图片、变成 `x²` 这种字符拼贴、
或者干脆留一堆 LaTeX 源码没人能改。

This plugin converts each formula through `LaTeX → MathML → OMML` and writes it
into the document as

a native equation, then verifies the result by exporting a
PDF and looking at every page.

这个插件把每个公式走 `LaTeX → MathML → OMML` 转成原生公式写进文档，
再把文档导出 PDF 逐页看图校验。
## Requirements / 依赖
| Need | Why |

| Python 3.9+ | runs the scripts |
| `pip install lxml latex2mathml python-docx` | conversion + docx

writing |
| `MML2OMML.XSL` | ships with Microsoft Office; auto-detected, or set `MML2OMML_XSL` |
|

Microsoft Word | only for the PDF preview pass (LibreOffice works as fallback) |
| `pip install pymu
pdf` | only for the preview pass |
Without Office you can still generate the docx — you just lose the visual check.

## The six traps / 六个坑
Every one of these was hit in production, and each has a fix:

1. A formula that appears twice renders as an empty box the second time —
the OMML node gets moved o

ut of its first parent. Cache with `deepcopy`.
2. `ns0:` prefixes appear in `document.xml` and WPS r

ejects the file —
declare `nsmap` at element creation, never `set` xmlns on a live node.
3. Chinese

characters inside `\text{}` break the conversion —
move the words out of the formula.
4. Numbered li

sts restart at 1 when a formula interrupts them —
render the original numbers from the Markdown.
5.

`**bold with $x$ inside**` prints the raw `$x$` —
the bold branch must recurse instead of emitting o

ne run.
6. `\xrightarrow` does not survive the OMML mapping —
split into formula + sentence + formul

run.
6. `\xrightarrow` does not survive the OMML mapping —
split into formula + sentence + formula.
Details and code: `references/pitfalls.md`.
## Verification is part of the job / 校验是流程的一部分

`check_docx.py` compares the equation count in the docx against the LaTeX in
the markdown sources. I

f they differ, a formula was dropped or double-rendered —
both are silent failures that only show up
as a blank box or a doubled formula.

`preview.py` exports a PDF through Word and renders every page to PNG.
Layout bugs (squeezed table c

olumns, an orphaned heading, a callout split across
pages) are invisible in the XML and obvious in t

n orphaned heading, a callout split across
pages) are invisible in the XML and obvious in the image.
